text:
maria-cs: Heads up — BeaconHR (LumenChat integration) is seeing webhook failures: ~15% 502s and a few timeouts starting ~03:15 UTC. Renewal call with them is next Fri; CS flagged as high priority. Can someone triage ingress/gateway? @lee-eng @olga-eng

incident-bot: ALERT: webhook-gateway error-rate spike (svc=webhook-gateway, 502s increased by 14% over 10m). See: https://ops.redwood/alerts/ALRT-9821

lee-eng: On it. I'll check LB -> gateway -> service chain. ETA 25–30m. Any failing request ids or sample payloads would help.

maria-cs: Sending failing request ids now and a short HAR. Example header we got from BeaconHR: `X-Customer-ID: beaconhr-124`

maria-cs: ```
Failed request id: 2026-03-05T03:18:24Z-req-7f3b
curl -v 'https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/webhooks' -H 'X-Customer-ID: beaconhr-124' --data-binary @sample.json
Response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

olga-eng: Quick standup-style note:
- what I did: re-reviewed gateway crash-loop logs from last month, confirmed a sticky bug with large payloads and header parsing.
- blockers: need the actual failing request bodies (size + content-type) and any client retry patterns.
- today: will pull full NGINX/gateway traces and look for header parsing errors, and prepare a fallback route.

ahmed-cs: FYI — BeaconHR reported the webhook as blocking their payroll sync; they're sensitive to data loss. If we need to propose a workaround, they'll accept a temporary polling fallback for the renewal call.

lee-eng: I pulled the gateway logs for the time window. Saw a recurring stack: `gateway: panic: handleRequest: unexpected EOF` tied to requests with `Content-Length > 1MB` when `X-Forwarded-Proto` header missing. Repro locally with sample payload >1MB.

olga-eng: Reproduced the 502 with the sample payload. Root cause candidate: our upstream HTTP client drops the body when a missing header triggers an early validation path.

lee-eng: Quick fix: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/webhook-gateway/pull/412 (adds header-check guard + safe-body-buffer). Will run canary on 2 nodes in us-west-2.

maria-cs: Thanks — can you mark the PR as emergency? Renewal team wants an ETA.

olga-eng: Canary started — routing 5% traffic to canary group. Monitoring error-rate and latency.

incident-bot: CANARY: webhook-gateway/canary deployment started (5% traffic).

lee-eng: Canary metrics look good at +12m. 502s dropped to baseline. Will promote to 50% for 10m then full.

sara-cs: Great — any temporary mitigations CS can enable for BeaconHR now? We can flip a routing rule on their account if needed.

olga-eng: Yes — we can flip them to the dedicated fallback endpoint (same infra, bypasses problematic header path). Need an opt-in flag on their org record. Maria, can you confirm you want me to flip?

maria-cs: Flip it for BeaconHR now please. Also adding note to the renewal playbook: mention fallback route + we need to confirm webhook payload sizes on onboarding.

olga-eng: Done — flipped their org to fallback endpoint at 03:58 UTC. Added a short lockdown rule to reject >5MB with a clear 413 instead of 502.

lee-eng: Promoted canary to 100% at 04:06 UTC. Post-deploy metrics show 502 rate normalized. I'll follow up with a postmortem PR describing root cause and recommended tests.

maria-cs: Thank you team — I'll update BeaconHR's renewal owner and add this to the customer incident note.

ahmed-cs: For the renewal conversation: can we include a short mitigation summary and ETA for permanent fix?

lee-eng: ETA for permanent fix (unit+integration tests + deploy): 48–72 hours. I'll link the postmortem and the PR once ready.

maria-cs: Perfect. No further blockers from CS side. Will close this thread after PM/Engineering postmortem links are attached. :thumbsup:
